correctness.rationale: For a stationary two-sided renewal process with W>0, mu=E W>0, E W² finite, equilibrium inspection gives E f(A,R)=(1/mu)E integral_0^W f(a,W-a) da. Conditional Brownian covariance at nonnegative lag t equals 2D A iff residual R>t, and vanishes after reset by independence, giving C(t)=(D/mu)E[(W-t)_+²]. Conditional cross-particle position covariance vanishes despite common reset times. Differentiation yields C’(t)=-(2D/mu)E(W-t)_+ and C’’_+(t)=2D/mu P(W>t), hence full waiting-law identification. Two integrations by parts give absolutely convergent positive spectral formula 4D/(mu omega²) integral_0^infty P(W>s)(1-cos omega s)ds. Riemann-Lebesgue gives universal 4D/omega² ultraviolet; dominated convergence or Fatou gives finite zero-frequency value iff E W³ finite, equal 2D E W³/(3mu). Elementary tail substitution gives exact Lomax power-law/logarithmic regimes for alpha>2. Independent exact/numerical checks covered deterministic and exponential renewals and four Lomax moment limits; the unrestricted analytic argument is separate. Formula interpreted as improper cosine transform for nonzero frequencies, no claim of absolute C integrability for infinite third moment.
